sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वायुसूनुर्वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।प्रहृतं हि मया पूर्वमक्षं स्मर सुतं तव ।। ६.५९.५९ ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāyusūnurvaco 'bravīt ।prahṛtaṁ hi mayā pūrvamakṣaṁ smara sutaṁ tava ।। 6.59.59 ।।।।

translations.english: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."
